description: Pre-online check (streaming): from asleep the vehicle only probes, and a bare online answer without vehicle data connects the stream to check whether the online is real before any vehicle data is requested. Branch 'stream inactive' sets the check idle, then a frame with power nil hits the branch 'subsystem check detected but check idle, treating as fake online': confirmed fake, further probes keep the machine asleep. Pin: only the asleep row, one stream connect. The bare online terminal repeats through the probe without writing.
